note: Seasons a team with a strong record played no postseason game, and why. Two classes. The team's own call: it declined a bid ('declined'), its school had a standing no-bowl policy ('school-policy'), or it imposed its own postseason ban ('self-ban'). A rule it was under: a conference barred bowls or allowed only the Rose Bowl ('conference-rule'), a conference no-repeat rule barred a return trip ('no-repeat'), or the NCAA banned it ('ncaa-ban'). The rest: the game was canceled ('canceled'), no bid came ('not-invited'), the team was ineligible ('ineligible'), or our data missed a bowl it played ('played', a flag bug recorded here). A streak lives through a game not played, so src/lib/unplayed.ts joins the first two classes to the winning runs that crossed them; the notes list each class on its own, because the anti-competitive criticism of a declined bowl doesn't reach a team that followed a conference rule. Rows were researched 2026-10-08 from the team-seasons with a strong record and no postseason game inside a long winning, undefeated or won-by-10+ run; each row carries receipts (url + verbatim quote), checked by scripts/data/check-receipts.mjs.
